test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following, after winning the Russian Grand Prix 2021, became the first F1 driver to win 100 races?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lewis Hamilton.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lewis Hamilton** made history, winning the Russian Grand Prix at** Sochi Autodrom** to become the first Formula **One racer ever to reach 100 victories.**
 
• Hamilton's win put him back in the **lead of the championship ahead of Max Verstappen**, who finished in second place.
 
• **In Formula One**, Hamilton has won a **joint-record seven World Drivers**' Championship titles, and holds the records for the most **wins, pole positions, and podium finishes, among others.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **George William Russell **is a British racing driver currently competing in Formula One for Mercedes.​ 
 
• **Valtteri Viktor Bottas** is a Finnish racing driver currently competing in Formula One for Alfa Romeo, having previously driven for **Mercedes from 2017 to 2021 and Williams from 2013 to 2016. **
 
• **Carlos Sainz Vázquez de Castro**, otherwise known as **Carlos Sainz Jr**. or simply Carlos Sainz, is a Spanish racing driver currently competing in Formula One for Scuderia Ferrari.
